What is intel-ipu7-camera?

This package builds and installs the driver stack needed to make the OV08X40 MIPI camera work on specific Intel 'Hurrican/Performance' reference laptops, using Intel's IPU7 hardware image signal processor (ISP). It's a hardware-enablement/installer package: it compiles kernel patches and firmware integration rather than providing any user-facing app, and is only relevant if you own that specific hardware.

Install intel-ipu7-camera on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add intel-ipu7-camera

Good to know

  • a Hurrican/Performance reference laptop with the OV08X40 camera and Intel IPU7 ISP
  • root privileges to build kernel modules and install firmware
  • a compatible kernel (project targets kernel 6.19.6-series patches)
